label: Amazon
description: Record of 10 orders and 15 items retrieved from Amazon

aspects.name: setup_instructions
attributes: Required: Amazon.ca cookies obtained via browser Dev Tools Network tab
Command to execute: node /workspace/tools/amazon.js set-cookies '<your cookies>'

aspects.name: setup_requirements
attributes: Requires full initial page load cookies before CAPTCHA challenges
Needs valid session-id and ubid-acbca tokens
Auth token (at-acbca) may rotate after logout
Cookies must be saved using 'set-cookies' command with proper formatting

aspects.name: authentication_requirements
attributes: Cookies require periodic renewal after logout
csd-key token requires validation for session integrity
